Caleb Kowalski
caleb.kowalski@example.com | Salt Lake City, UT
Caleb Kowalski has 14 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Principal Backend Engineer at Harborlight Solutions (2025-2026),
where they led migration of core services at Harborlight Solutions onto
PostgreSQL, improving uptime during peak load. Before that, Staff Backend
Engineer at Redbank Data (2023-2025). Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at
Lattice Platform (2012-2023). Education: Ph.D. Software Engineering, Arizona
State University, 2012; B.S. Software Engineering, Virginia Tech, 2007. Core
skills: Elasticsearch, CI/CD, Redis, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Distributed systems,
REST API design, TypeScript, Go, Kafka, AWS, gRPC.
